text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe wins the Kikuka Sho. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer's forced presence went 
unpunished. After all, the Trainer license 
discrepancy had been a clerical error on 
the URA's part.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two choose the Japan Cup as their next 
race. In order to surpass the "GATE"—the 
Tenno Sho (Spring)— they will build up 
experience at medium distances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Neo Universe speaks: after the Japan 
Cup, she will reveal a grave prediction 
for the future.
